title: Build a silent install package
symptom: IT needs to install an app on many PCs without anyone clicking through the installer
user_description: We need the new timesheet app on 200 PCs next week. Nobody should have to click through the installer. Can you prepare it?

options.text: Use the installer's documented silent switches (for MSI files, msiexec /i app.msi /qn), test on a test PC first, then deploy with the deployment tool
options.why: Silent switches install without screens. Testing first catches problems before they hit 200 users.

options.text: Deploy it straight to everyone without testing
options.why: One mistake would break the install on all 200 PCs at once.

options.text: Click through the installer on all 200 PCs by hand
options.why: Slow, error-prone, and exactly what silent installs avoid.

options.text: Ask users to install it themselves
options.why: Most users do not have admin rights, and installs would be inconsistent.

hints: Can installers run without showing any screens?
Where do you find the right switches for an installer?
What should happen before it goes to 200 PCs?
real_world_tip: Check the vendor's documentation for the switches. Non-MSI installers each use their own, and guessing can cause a half-finished install.
